findings.detail: Phase audio graph construction starts resources before committing them to instance fields. If a later construction step or the second oscillator start throws, dispose cannot reach the partially started oscillators or AudioContext; the production caller suppresses the rejected start promise.
evidence: independent injected failure: disposed snapshot with contextClosed=false and both started oscillators stopped=false

verified_evidence.manifest: 412/412 entries matched implementation blobs, modes, and sizes
verified_evidence.build_archive: 8201728 bytes / 128 entries / zero unsafe, link, or AppleDouble entries

required_remediation: Construct the graph fail-closed with local ownership until every step succeeds.
On every construction failure, stop all started oscillators, disconnect partial nodes, close the AudioContext, clear graph state, and rethrow without masking the original error.
Prove every construction stage with failure injection, including second oscillator start and cleanup failures; keep dispose idempotent.
